resources.string: Every camera that took your photos and videos, as their tags say. Turn off one that isn’t yours: its photos move to Sent to you, on all your devices.
A camera you haven’t marked counts as yours, so nothing moves until you choose.
Its photos are in Sent to you
They stay on your server and in the app, under Sent to you instead of Camera. Mark the %1$s yours again to bring them back.
